## What & why

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check` pass
- [ ] For Rust changes: `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml` passes
- [ ] The byte-for-byte round-trip guarantee still holds (no lossy load/save)
- [ ] New in-file constructs degrade gracefully in a plain-Markdown viewer
